phases.objective: Allow binary-protected identifier comparisons against columns declared by CREATE TABLE in the same migration to defer to same-cycle schema readback without weakening fail-closed validation for legacy or unprotected identifiers.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A migration contains CREATE TABLE declarations and canonical identifier comparisons that reference both new and existing schema columns.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Only binary-protected comparisons whose missing side is declared in the same migration are deferred while missing legacy columns and unprotected comparisons remain blocking.
steps: Parse CREATE TABLE declarations from the migration SQL.
Resolve the canonical identifier comparison contracts against live schema metadata.
Defer a missing column only when exactly that column is declared by the same migration and the comparison is binary-protected.
Keep legacy missing columns and unprotected comparisons as blocking issues.
Expose deferred schema-column evidence for same-cycle readback.
assertions: The connection ownership migration reports seven canonical comparisons and three deferred new columns with zero blocking issues.
A missing legacy identifier column remains blocked even when the comparison uses BINARY protection.
A same-migration new column remains blocked when the comparison is not binary-protected.
Deferred schema columns are explicitly reported rather than silently ignored.

phases.objective: Expose deferred same-migration identifier comparisons in migration preflight diagnostics and operator evidence.
Cover additional CREATE TABLE syntax variants and mixed live/new identifier comparison sets.
Observe governed migration dry-runs using deferred same-migration schema evidence in non-production environments.
Require same-cycle schema readback before any deferred identifier comparison is accepted after migration apply.
